title: The Dynific Addons for Elementor (formerly Anywhere Elementor) WordPress plugin before 1.3.1 does not escape a…
description: The Dynific Addons for Elementor WordPress plugin versions before 1.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. This flaw allows authenticated users with the Author role to inject malicious scripts via a user-controlled profile value that is not properly escaped in a quoted attribute within an Elementor widget. When an administrator or any user views a post authored by the attacker, the stored payload executes in their session.
